hero.title: Brabus Island Baku
hero.subtitle: An exclusive residential concept co-created through the brand partnership of Sabah Investment Group (SIG) and BRABUS.

about.title: BRUTAL AND RIGID ENGINEERING REFLECTED IN ARCHITECTURE
about.description: BRABUS ISLAND Baku brings the "One-Second-Wow" philosophy of BRABUS, Germany's bold supercar and engineering brand, to the shores of the Caspian Sea. Developed by RS Capital (a collaboration between Sabah Investment Group and Reportage Group), the official sales are handled by Treva Real Estate. It is a unique waterfront residence vision shaped by sharp lines, monochrome aesthetics, and pure BRABUS DNA-defying conventional living standards.

exterior.titleRegular: AN ENGINEERING ISLAND ON THE CASPIAN SHORE
exterior.description: Baku, Sea Breeze coast. Sharp wave-like structures, dark monochrome materials, and strong vertical lines lend the building a dominant architectural presence.
exterior.caption: * Visuals displayed in this section are digital architectural renders. Current construction and execution status is regularly updated by the developer.

interior.description: Interiors inspired by supercar architecture. Carbon fiber elements, sharp contrasts, and advanced material engineering transform each residence into the owner's personal BRABUS Masterpiece. Character and ergonomics take precedence over generic comfort.

items.label: Residences & pool
items.title: Twin villas
items.description: A brutal unity of form and function. Maximum floor efficiency, glass structures, and direct sea access. Every villa has its own private garden and private pool.

items.label: Residences & pool
items.title: Recovery zone
items.description: A dedicated, secluded zone for residents. A sea-view pool complex designed for complete relaxation.

items.label: Restricted-access zones
items.title: Fitness & spa area
items.description: A fully equipped fitness zone and separate men's/women's saunas for privacy, along with a modern hammam and massage rooms.

items.label: Restricted-access zones
items.title: Residents' lounge
items.description: Enclosed spaces for business communication. A distinct atmosphere shaped by minimalist architecture and bespoke lighting.

footer.sigDescription: A leading investment holding shaping the living environment of the future through innovative projects that create value in the region, a distinct perspective on architecture, and a philosophy of sustainable development.
footer.collabDescription: A global icon of bold German engineering, bringing its "One-Second-Wow" philosophy, high-performance DNA, and German precision to the Caspian coast for the first time in an artificial island concept.

Legal, construction, contracting, and commercial obligations regarding the project belong to the developer (Sabah Investment Group) and its official representatives.
